title: An experimental protocol for video recording with a smartphone for use in a pre-trained neural network
author: Nardo, José Renato Munari
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Set up recording apparatus
steps.instruction: Attach the smartphone to the custom‑made support and position the support so that the sheet with the drawing patterns (spiral and sinusoidal wave) is in the camera’s field of view, ensuring stable placement and correct orientation.

substeps.instruction: Secure the smartphone on its support.
Place the sheet with the spiral and sinusoidal wave drawings on the support beneath the camera.

steps.title: Instruct volunteer to perform test
steps.instruction: Ask the volunteer to draw the prescribed patterns (a spiral format and a sinusoidal wave) on the sheet while being recorded.

steps.title: Record the drawing session
steps.instruction: Start the smartphone camera and record the entire drawing motion, keeping the camera steady and the entire drawing area visible throughout the session.

steps.title: Analyze video with DeepLabCut
steps.instruction: Load the recorded video into DeepLabCut and run the authors’ pre‑trained neural network to perform object‑recognition and track the movement of the hand/pen.

steps.title: Extract movement data for analysis
steps.instruction: Export the tracked coordinates and derived metrics from DeepLabCut for downstream analysis aimed at detecting Parkinson’s disease or classifying its stage.
